verses.en: Verily I say unto you, concerning your brethren who have been afflicted, and persecuted, and cast out from the land of their inheritance—
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e uiga i o outou uso o e ua puapuagatia, ma ua sauaina, ma ua tutuliese mai le laueleele o lo latou tofi—

verses.en: I, the Lord, have suffered the affliction to come upon them, wherewith they have been afflicted, in consequence of their transgressions;
verses.sm: O A’u, o le Alii, na Ou tuu le puapuaga ia oo mai i o latou luga, lea ua latou puapuagatia ai, ona o a latou soligatulafono;

verses.en: Yet I will own them, and they shall be mine in that day when I shall come to make up my jewels.
verses.sm: Peitai o le a A’u i latou, ma o le a avea i latou mo’u i lena aso o le a Ou alu atu ai e faaputuputu a’u maa tāua.

verses.en: Therefore, they must needs be chastened and tried, even as Abraham, who was commanded to offer up his only son.
verses.sm: O lea, e tatau ai ona aoa’iina ma tofotofoina i latou, e pei lava o Aperaamo, o lē na poloaiina e tuu atu lona atalii e toatasi.

verses.en: For all those who will not endure chastening, but deny me, cannot be sanctified.
verses.sm: Aua o i latou uma o e e lē onosaia le aoa’iga, ae teena a’u, e lē mafai ona faapaiaina.

verses.en: Behold, I say unto you, there were jarrings, and contentions, and envyings, and strifes, and lustful and covetous desires among them; therefore by these things they polluted their inheritances.
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, sa i ai misa, ma finauga, ma losilosivalega, ma fetauaiga, ma tuinanauga ma manaoga matape’ape’a i totonu o i latou; o lea na latou faaeleelea ai o latou tofi i ia mea.

verses.en: They were slow to hearken unto the voice of the Lord their God; therefore, the Lord their God is slow to hearken unto their prayers, to answer them in the day of their trouble.
verses.sm: Sa gese ona latou faalogo i le siufofoga o le Alii lo latou Atua; o lea, ua gese ai ona faafofoga mai o le Alii lo latou Atua ia latou tatalo, e tali mai i latou i le aso o lo latou faalavelave.

verses.en: In the day of their peace they esteemed lightly my counsel; but, in the day of their trouble, of necessity they feel after me.
verses.sm: I le aso o lo latou filemu sa latou manatu māmā ai i la’u fautuaga; ae, i le aso o lo latou faalavelave, latou te saili e aapa mai ia te a’u ona ua tatau ai.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, notwithstanding their sins, my bowels are filled with compassion towards them. I will not utterly cast them off; and in the day of wrath I will remember mercy.
verses.sm: E moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, e ui i a latou agasala, ua tumu o’u lagona i le agaalofa ia te i latou. O le a Ou lē lafoaia ese atoatoa i latou; ma o le a Ou manatua le alofa mutimutivale i le aso o le toasa.

verses.en: I have sworn, and the decree hath gone forth by a former commandment which I have given unto you, that I would let fall the sword of mine indignation in behalf of my people; and even as I have said, it shall come to pass.
verses.sm: Ua Ou tauto, ma ua tuuina atu le folafolaga e ala i se uluai poloaiga na Ou tuuina atu ia te outou, o le a Ou faatoilaloina i le pelu o lo’u ita mo lo’u nuu; ma e pei ona Ou fai atu, o le a faapea lava ona faataunuuina.

verses.en: Mine indignation is soon to be poured out without measure upon all nations; and this will I do when the cup of their iniquity is full.
verses.sm: Ua lata ona faalautele atu lo’u ita lē faatapulaaina i luga o atunuu uma; ma o le a Ou faia lenei mea pe a tumu le ipu o lo latou amioletonu.

verses.en: And in that day all who are found upon the watch-tower, or in other words, all mine Israel, shall be saved.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso, o i latou uma o e e maua i luga o le ’olo-vaai, po o i ni isi upu, o la’u Isaraelu uma, o le a faaolaina.

verses.en: And they that have been scattered shall be gathered.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e sa faataapeapeina o le a faapotopotoina.

verses.en: And all they who have mourned shall be comforted.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou uma o e sa faanoanoa o le a faamafanafanaina.

verses.en: And all they who have given their lives for my name shall be crowned.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou uma o e sa tuu atu o latou ola ona o lo’u igoa o le a faapaleina.

verses.en: Therefore, let your hearts be comforted concerning Zion; for all flesh is in mine hands; be still and know that I am God.
verses.sm: O lea, ia faamafanafanaina o outou loto e faatatau ia Siona; aua ua i ai tagata uma i o’u lima; ia filemu ma iloa o A’u o le Atua.

verses.en: Zion shall not be moved out of her place, notwithstanding her children are scattered.
verses.sm: O le a lē aveesea Siona i fafo mai lona nofoaga, e ui ina faataapeapeina ana fanau.

verses.en: They that remain, and are pure in heart, shall return, and come to their inheritances, they and their children, with songs of everlasting joy, to build up the waste places of Zion—
verses.sm: O i latou o e e totoe, ma ua mamā i loto, o le a toe foi mai, ma toe maua o latou tofi, o i latou ma a latou fanau, faatasi ma pese o le olioli tumau e faavavau, e atia’e nofoaga tuufua o Siona—

verses.en: And all these things that the prophets might be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai nei mea uma ina ia mafai ona faataunuuina valoaga a perofeta.

verses.en: And, behold, there is none other place appointed than that which I have appointed; neither shall there be any other place appointed than that which I have appointed, for the work of the gathering of my saints—
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, e leai se isi nofoaga ua tofia nai lo lena ua Ou tofia; pe o le a i ai se isi nofoaga e tofia nai lo lena ua Ou tofia, mo le galuega o le faapotopotoina o la’u au paia—

verses.en: Until the day cometh when there is found no more room for them; and then I have other places which I will appoint unto them, and they shall be called stakes, for the curtains or the strength of Zion.
verses.sm: Seia oo mai le aso e lē toe maua ai se avanoa mo i latou; ma ona i ai lea ia te A’u isi nofoaga o le a Ou tofi atu ia te i latou, ma o le a ta’ua i latou o siteki, mo pupuni po o le malosi o Siona.

verses.en: Behold, it is my will, that all they who call on my name, and worship me according to mine everlasting gospel, should gather together, and stand in holy places;
verses.sm: Faauta, o lo’u lava loto, o i latou uma o e e valaau mai i lo’u igoa, ma tapuai mai ia te a’u e tusa ma la’u talalelei tumau e faavavau, e tatau ona faapotopoto faatasi, ma tutulai i nofoaga paia;

verses.en: And prepare for the revelation which is to come, when the veil of the covering of my temple, in my tabernacle, which hideth the earth, shall be taken off, and all flesh shall see me together.
verses.sm: Ma sauni mo le faaaliga o le a oo mai, pe a to ese le veli o le ufiufi o lo’u malumalu, i totonu o lo’u fale fetafai, lea ua natia ai le lalolagi, ma o le a vaai faatasi ai tagata uma ia te a’u.

verses.en: And every corruptible thing, both of man, or of the beasts of the field, or of the fowls of the heavens, or of the fish of the sea, that dwells upon all the face of the earth, shall be consumed;
verses.sm: Ma o mea uma e pala, po o a tagata, po o a manu o le fanua, po o a manufelelei o le lagi, po o a ī’a o le sami, e mau i luga o le lalolagi atoa, o le a susunuina;

verses.en: And also that of element shall melt with fervent heat; and all things shall become new, that my knowledge and glory may dwell upon all the earth.
verses.sm: Ma o mea foi o le elemene o le a liusuavai i le vevela tele; ma o mea uma o le a faafouina, ina ia mafai ona mau o lo’u poto ma lo’u mamalu i le lalolagi uma.

verses.en: And in that day the enmity of man, and the enmity of beasts, yea, the enmity of all flesh, shall cease from before my face.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso o le feitaga’i o tagata, ma le feitaga’i o manu, ioe, o le feitaga’i o meaola ma tagata uma, o le a taofia mai o’u luma.

verses.en: And in that day whatsoever any man shall ask, it shall be given unto him.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso soo se mea e ole atu ai soo se tagata, o le a tuu mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And in that day Satan shall not have power to tempt any man.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso o le a leai se mana ia Satani e faaosooso ai soo se tagata.

verses.en: And there shall be no sorrow because there is no death.
verses.sm: Ma o le a leai se faanoanoa aua o le a leai se oti.

verses.en: In that day an infant shall not die until he is old; and his life shall be as the age of a tree;
verses.sm: I lena aso o le a lē oti se tamameamea seia matua o ia; ma o lona ola o le a pei o tausaga o se laau;

verses.en: And when he dies he shall not sleep, that is to say in the earth, but shall be changed in the twinkling of an eye, and shall be caught up, and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.sm: Ma pe a oti o ia o le a lē moe o ia, o lona uiga i le eleele, ae o le a liua i le emo o le mata, ma o le a segia i luga, ma o le a mamalu lava lona malologa.

verses.en: Yea, verily I say unto you, in that day when the Lord shall come, he shall reveal all things—
verses.sm: Ioe, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, i lena aso pe a afio mai le Alii, o le a faaali mai e ia mea uma—

verses.en: Things which have passed, and hidden things which no man knew, things of the earth, by which it was made, and the purpose and the end thereof—
verses.sm: O mea ua mavae atu, ma mea natia sa lei iloa e se tagata, o mea o le lalolagi, o mea na faia ai, ma lona faamoemoega ma lona iuga—

verses.en: Things most precious, things that are above, and things that are beneath, things that are in the earth, and upon the earth, and in heaven.
verses.sm: O mea sili ona pele, o mea o i lugā, ma mea o i lalō, o mea o i totonu o le lalolagi, ma luga o le lalolagi, ma i le lagi.

verses.en: And all they who suffer persecution for my name, and endure in faith, though they are called to lay down their lives for my sake yet shall they partake of all this glory.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou uma o e e mafatia i sauaga ona o lo’u igoa, ma tumau i le faatuatua, e ui ina valaauina i latou e tuu atu o latou ola mo a’u ae o le a tofusia i latou i lenei mamalu.

verses.en: Wherefore, fear not even unto death; for in this world your joy is not full, but in me your joy is full.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, aua le fefefe e oo lava i le oti; ona e lē atoatoa lo outou olioli i le lalolagi lenei, ae o a’u e atoatoa ai lo outou olioli.

verses.en: Therefore, care not for the body, neither the life of the body; but care for the soul, and for the life of the soul.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, aua le popole i le tino, po o le ola o le tino; ae ia popole i le agaga, ma le ola o le agaga.

verses.en: And seek the face of the Lord always, that in patience ye may possess your souls, and ye shall have eternal life.
verses.sm: Ma ia saili fofoga o le Alii i taimi uma, ina ia mafai ona outou maua o outou agaga i le onosai, ma o le a outou maua ai le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: When men are called unto mine everlasting gospel, and covenant with an everlasting covenant, they are accounted as the salt of the earth and the savor of men;
verses.sm: A valaaulia tagata i la’u talalelei tumau e faavavau, ma osifeagaiga i se feagaiga tumau e faavavau, e faitauina i latou o le masima o le lalolagi ma le faaola o tagata;

verses.en: They are called to be the savor of men; therefore, if that salt of the earth lose its savor, behold, it is thenceforth good for nothing only to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
verses.sm: Ua valaaulia i latou e avea ma faaola o tagata; o lea, afai e toesea le malosi faaola o le masima o le lalolagi, faauta, e mai i lena taimi ona lē toe aoga ai mo se mea, na’o le lafoa’iina i fafo ma soli i lalo i vae o tagata.

verses.en: Behold, here is wisdom concerning the children of Zion, even many, but not all; they were found transgressors, therefore they must needs be chastened—
verses.sm: Faauta, o le poto lenei e faatatau i fanau a Siona, le toatele lea, ae lē o i latou uma; na maua i latou o ni tagata solitulafono, o lea e tatau ai ona aoa’iina i latou—

verses.en: He that exalteth himself shall be abased, and he that abaseth himself shall be exalted.
verses.sm: O ia o lē na te faaeaina o ia lava o le a faamaualaloina, ma o ia o lē na te faamaualalo o ia lava o le a faaeaina.

verses.en: And now, I will show unto you a parable, that you may know my will concerning the redemption of Zion.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, o le a Ou faaali atu ia te outou se faataoto, ina ia mafai ona outou iloa lo’u loto e faatatau i le laveaiina o Siona.

verses.en: A certain nobleman had a spot of land, very choice; and he said unto his servants: Go ye unto my vineyard, even upon this very choice piece of land, and plant twelve olive trees;
verses.sm: E i ai se tasi alii sili sa i ai se fasi fanua, sa silisili lava ona lelei; ma sa fai atu o ia i ana auauna: Ia outou o atu i lo’u tovine, i luga o lenei lava fasi fanua silisili ona lelei, ma totō ai ni laau olive e sefulu ma le lua;

verses.en: And set watchmen round about them, and build a tower, that one may overlook the land round about, to be a watchman upon the tower, that mine olive trees may not be broken down when the enemy shall come to spoil and take upon themselves the fruit of my vineyard.
verses.sm: Ma faatutu ni leoleo faataamilo ia i latou, ma fausia se olo, ina ia mafai e se toatasi ona vaavaai atu i le fanua faataamilo, e avea o se leoleo i luga o le olo, ina ia lē gauia i lalo o’u laau olive pe a sau le fili e faaleaga ma ave mo i latou lava le fua o lo’u tovine.

verses.en: Now, the servants of the nobleman went and did as their lord commanded them, and planted the olive trees, and built a hedge round about, and set watchmen, and began to build a tower.
verses.sm: O lenei, sa o atu auauna a le alii sili ma faia e pei ona sa poloaiina ai i latou e lo latou alii, ma toto laau olive, ma fausia se pa faataamilo, ma faatutu ni leoleo, ma amata ona fausia se olo.

verses.en: And while they were yet laying the foundation thereof, they began to say among themselves: And what need hath my lord of this tower?
verses.sm: Ma a’o latou faataatia lona faavae i lea lava taimi, sa amata ona latou fai ane i totonu o i latou lava: Ma o se a se mea ua manaomia ai e lo’u alii lenei olo?

verses.en: And consulted for a long time, saying among themselves: What need hath my lord of this tower, seeing this is a time of peace?
verses.sm: Ma sa talanoa mo se taimi umi lava, ua fai ane i totonu o i latou lava: O le a se mea ua manaomia ai e lo’u alii lenei olo, talu ai o le taimi lenei o le filemu?

verses.en: Might not this money be given to the exchangers? For there is no need of these things.
verses.sm: E lē mafai ea ona avatu lenei tupe i e suitupe? Ona ua leai se manaomia o nei mea.

verses.en: And while they were at variance one with another they became very slothful, and they hearkened not unto the commandments of their lord.
verses.sm: Ma a’o latou fefinaua’i o le tasi ma le isi sa oo ina latou faapaie tele, ma sa latou lē faalogo i poloaiga a lo latou alii.

verses.en: And the enemy came by night, and broke down the hedge; and the servants of the nobleman arose and were affrighted, and fled; and the enemy destroyed their works, and broke down the olive trees.
verses.sm: Ma sa sau le fili i le po, ma lepeti i lalo le pa; ma sa tutu i luga auauna a le alii sili ma sa fefefe, ma ua sosola; ma sa faaleaga e le fili a latou galuega, ma gaui i lalo laau olive.

verses.en: Now, behold, the nobleman, the lord of the vineyard, called upon his servants, and said unto them, Why! what is the cause of this great evil?
verses.sm: O lenei, faauta, sa valaau e le alii sili, le pule o le tovine, ana auauna, ma fai atu ia te i latou, Aisea! o le a le pogai o lenei leaga tele?

verses.en: Ought ye not to have done even as I commanded you, and—after ye had planted the vineyard, and built the hedge round about, and set watchmen upon the walls thereof—built the tower also, and set a watchman upon the tower, and watched for my vineyard, and not have fallen asleep, lest the enemy should come upon you?
verses.sm: Sa lē tatau ea ona outou faia e pei ona Ou poloaiina ai outou, ma— ina ua uma ona outou toto le tovine, ma fai le pa faataamilo ai, ma faatutu ni leoleo i luga o ona puipui— fausia foi le olo, ma faatutu ni leoleo i luga o le olo, ma leoleo i lo’u tovine, ma lē momoe lava, ne’i sau i o outou luga le fili?

verses.en: And behold, the watchman upon the tower would have seen the enemy while he was yet afar off; and then ye could have made ready and kept the enemy from breaking down the hedge thereof, and saved my vineyard from the hands of the destroyer.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, semanu e iloa atu e le leoleo i luga o le olo le fili a’o mamao atu o ia; ma semanu na mafai ai ona outou sauni ma taofi le fili mai le lepetia i lalo o lona pa, ma faasao ai lo’u tovine mai lima o lē faaumatia.

verses.en: And the lord of the vineyard said unto one of his servants: Go and gather together the residue of my servants, and take all the strength of mine house, which are my warriors, my young men, and they that are of middle age also among all my servants, who are the strength of mine house, save those only whom I have appointed to tarry;
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu le alii o le tovine i se tasi o ana auauna: Alu ma faapotopoto mai faatasi e o totoe o a’u auauna, ma ave le malosi uma o lo’u fale, o a’u tagata tau ia, o a’u alii talavou, ma i latou o faamatuā tagata foi o i totonu o a’u auauna uma, o e o le malosi o lo’u fale, vagana ai i latou o e ua ou tofia e nonofo;

verses.en: And go ye straightway unto the land of my vineyard, and redeem my vineyard; for it is mine; I have bought it with money.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou o atu vave i le fanua o lo’u tovine, ma toe faaola mai lo’u tovine; ona e a a’u; sa ou faatauina i tupe.

verses.en: Therefore, get ye straightway unto my land; break down the walls of mine enemies; throw down their tower, and scatter their watchmen.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou o atu vave i lo’u fanua; lepeti i lalo pa o o’u fili; lafo i lalo lo latou olo, ma faataapeape o latou leoleo.

verses.en: And inasmuch as they gather together against you, avenge me of mine enemies, that by and by I may come with the residue of mine house and possess the land.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo latou potopoto faatasi e faasaga mai ia te outou, ia tauimasui a’u i o’u fili, ina ia vave ona ou alu atu faatasi ma e o totoe o lo’u fale ma nonofo i le fanua.

verses.en: And the servant said unto his lord: When shall these things be?
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu le auauna i lona alii: O afea o le a i ai ia mea?

verses.en: And he said unto his servant: When I will; go ye straightway, and do all things whatsoever I have commanded you;
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu o ia i lana auauna: Pe a ou loto i ai; alu atu vave ia oe, ma fai mea uma ua ou poloaiina ai oe;

verses.en: And this shall be my seal and blessing upon you—a faithful and wise steward in the midst of mine house, a ruler in my kingdom.
verses.sm: Ma o le a avea lenei ma a’u faamaufaailoga ma faamanuiaga i ou luga— o se tausimea faamaoni ma le atamai i totonu o lo’u fale, o se pule i lo’u malo.

verses.en: And his servant went straightway, and did all things whatsoever his lord commanded him; and after many days all things were fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ma sa alu atu vave lana auauna, ma faia mea uma o soo se mea na poloaiina ai o ia e lona alii; ma ina ua mavae aso e tele sa faataunuuina mea uma.

verses.en: Again, verily I say unto you, I will show unto you wisdom in me concerning all the churches, inasmuch as they are willing to be guided in a right and proper way for their salvation—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a Ou faaali atu ia te outou le poto o ia te a’u e faatatau i aulotu uma, e tusa ai ma lo latou loto ia taitaiina i latou i se ala sa’o ma tatau ai mo lo latou faaolataga—

verses.en: That the work of the gathering together of my saints may continue, that I may build them up unto my name upon holy places; for the time of harvest is come, and my word must needs be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona faaauau o le galuega o le faapotopotoina faatasi o la’u au paia, ina ia mafai ona Ou atia’e o i latou i lo’u igoa i luga o nofoaga paia; ona ua oo mai le taimi o le seleselega, ma ua tatau ona faataunuuina o la’u upu.

verses.en: Therefore, I must gather together my people, according to the parable of the wheat and the tares, that the wheat may be secured in the garners to possess eternal life, and be crowned with celestial glory, when I shall come in the kingdom of my Father to reward every man according as his work shall be;
verses.sm: O lea, e ao ina Ou faapotopoto faatasi lo’u nuu, e tusa ma le faataoto i le saito ma titania, ina ia mafai ona faasaoina o saito i le faleteusaito ia maua le ola e faavavau, ma faapaleina i le mamalu selesitila, pe a Ou alu atu i le malo o lo’u Tamā e taui i tagata taitoatasi e tusa ma ana galuega e pei o le a i ai;

verses.en: While the tares shall be bound in bundles, and their bands made strong, that they may be burned with unquenchable fire.
verses.sm: A’o titania o le a noatia i fusi, ma o le a faamalolosi o latou noanoa, ina ia susunuina i latou i le afi e lē matineia.

verses.en: Therefore, a commandment I give unto all the churches, that they shall continue to gather together unto the places which I have appointed.
verses.sm: O lea, Ou te tuu atu se poloaiga i aulotu uma, ia faaauau pea ona latou faapotopoto faatasi i nofoaga ua Ou tofia i ai.

verses.en: Nevertheless, as I have said unto you in a former commandment, let not your gathering be in haste, nor by flight; but let all things be prepared before you.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, e pei ona Ou fai atu ia te outou i se poloaiga muamua, aua le faanatinatia lo outou faapotopotoina, pe i se sola’aga; ae ia mua’i saunia mea uma i o outou luma.

verses.en: And in order that all things be prepared before you, observe the commandment which I have given concerning these things—
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai ona mua’i saunia mea uma i o outou luma, ia tausi i le poloaiga ua Ou tuuina atu e faatatau i nei mea—

verses.en: Which saith, or teacheth, to purchase all the lands with money, which can be purchased for money, in the region round about the land which I have appointed to be the land of Zion, for the beginning of the gathering of my saints;
verses.sm: Lea ua fai mai, pe ua aoao mai, ia faatau mai fanua uma i tupe, e mafai ona faatauina i tupe, i le itulagi faataamilo i le laueleele ua Ou tofia e avea ma laueleele o Siona, mo le amataga o le faapotopotoina o la’u au paia;

verses.en: All the land which can be purchased in Jackson county, and the counties round about, and leave the residue in mine hand.
verses.sm: O laueleele uma e mafai ona faatau mai i le itumalo o Siakisone, ma itumalo faataamilo ai, ma tuu mai le vaega e totoe i lo’u lima.

verses.en: Now, verily I say unto you, let all the churches gather together all their moneys; let these things be done in their time, but not in haste; and observe to have all things prepared before you.
verses.sm: O lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i aulotu uma e faaputuputu faatasi a latou tupe uma; ia tuu atu ia mea ia faia i o latou taimi, ae lē i le faanatinati; ma vaai ia mua’i saunia mea uma i o outou luma.

verses.en: And let honorable men be appointed, even wise men, and send them to purchase these lands.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu e tofia ni alii mamalu, o ni tagata atamamai lava, ma auina atu i latou e faatau mai ia laueleele.

verses.en: And the churches in the eastern countries, when they are built up, if they will hearken unto this counsel they may buy lands and gather together upon them; and in this way they may establish Zion.
verses.sm: Ma o aulotu i itu-laueleele i sasa’e, a atia’e i luga i latou, afai latou te faalogo i lenei fautuaga e mafai ona latou faatau mai laueleele ma faapotopoto faatasi ai i luga; ma i lenei ala e mafai ona faamautuina ai i latou i Siona.

verses.en: There is even now already in store sufficient, yea, even an abundance, to redeem Zion, and establish her waste places, no more to be thrown down, were the churches, who call themselves after my name, willing to hearken to my voice.
verses.sm: Ua i ai i le taimi nei lava ni mea ua uma ona teuina, ioe, ua tele lava, e toe faaola mai ai Siona, ma faamaumaututu ai ona nofoaga tuufua, e lē toe lafoina i lalo, pe a na loto aulotu, o e ua ta’ua i latou lava i lo’u igoa, e faalogo mai i lo’u leo.

verses.en: And again I say unto you, those who have been scattered by their enemies, it is my will that they should continue to importune for redress, and redemption, by the hands of those who are placed as rulers and are in authority over you—
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, o i latou o e na faataapeapeina e o latou fili, o lo’u loto e tatau ona latou faaauau pea ona tagi atu mo le toe totogi mai, ma le toe faaola mai, e ala i lima o i latou o e ua tuu e avea ma pule ma ua i ai le pule i luga o outou—

verses.en: According to the laws and constitution of the people, which I have suffered to be established, and should be maintained for the rights and protection of all flesh, according to just and holy principles;
verses.sm: E tusa ma tulafono ma le tulafono faavae a le atunuu, lea na Ou tuu ia faatuina, ma e tatau ona tausia mo aiā tatau ma le puipuiga o tagata uma, e tusa ma mataupu autu tonu ma paia;

verses.en: That every man may act in doctrine and principle pertaining to futurity, according to the moral agency which I have given unto him, that every man may be accountable for his own sins in the day of judgment.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai e tagata taitoatasi ona faia e tusa ma mataupu faavae ma mataupu autu e faatatau i le lumanai, e tusa ma le faitalia ua Ou tuu atu ia te ia, ina ia mafai e tagata taitoatasi ona tali mo ana lava agasala i le aso o le faamasinoga.

verses.en: Therefore, it is not right that any man should be in bondage one to another.
verses.sm: O lea, e lē sa’o ona tatau ona nofo pologa soo se tagata o le tasi i le isi.

verses.en: And for this purpose have I established the Constitution of this land, by the hands of wise men whom I raised up unto this very purpose, and redeemed the land by the shedding of blood.
verses.sm: Ma o le faamoemoega lenei na Ou faatuina ai le Tulafono Faavae o le laueleele lenei, e ala i lima o alii atamamai o e na Ou faatutuina mai i luga mo lenei lava faamoemoe, ma toe maua mai le laueleele e ala i le faamasaaina o le toto.

verses.en: Now, unto what shall I liken the children of Zion? I will liken them unto the parable of the woman and the unjust judge, for men ought always to pray and not to faint, which saith—
verses.sm: O lenei, o se a se mea a Ou faatusa i ai fanau a Siona? O le a Ou faatusaina i latou i le faataoto e uiga i le fafine ma le faamasino amioletonu, aua e tatau i tagata ona tatalo e lē aunoa ma ia lē vaivai, ua fai mai—

verses.en: There was in a city a judge which feared not God, neither regarded man.
verses.sm: Sa i ai i se aai se faamasino sa lē mata’u i le Atua, pe sa ava i tagata.

verses.en: And there was a widow in that city, and she came unto him, saying: Avenge me of mine adversary.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai i lena aai se fafine ua oti lana tane, ma sa alu atu le fafine i le faamasino, ua fai atu: Ia e tauimasui i lo’u fili.

verses.en: And he would not for a while, but afterward he said within himself: Though I fear not God, nor regard man, yet because this widow troubleth me I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.sm: Ma sa lē faia e le faamasino mo se taimi, ae mulimuli ane ua fai ifo o ia i totonu o ia lava: E ui ina ou lē mata’u i le Atua, pe ava i tagata, ae ona o le faalavelave mai ia te a’u o lenei fafine ua oti lana tane o le a ou tauimasui atu ai mo ia, ne’i ou fiu i lona sau soo.

verses.en: Thus will I liken the children of Zion.
verses.sm: O le a faapea ona Ou faatusaina o fanau a Siona.

verses.en: Let them importune at the feet of the judge;
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i latou e tagi atu i vae o le faamasino;

verses.en: And if he heed them not, let them importune at the feet of the governor;
verses.sm: Ma afai e lē amanaia i latou e ia, ia tuu atu ia te i latou e tagi atu i vae o le kovana;

verses.en: And if the governor heed them not, let them importune at the feet of the president;
verses.sm: Ma afai e lē amanaia i latou e le kovana, ia tuu atu ia te i latou e tagi atu i vae o le peresitene;

verses.en: And if the president heed them not, then will the Lord arise and come forth out of his hiding place, and in his fury vex the nation;
verses.sm: Ma afai e lē amanaia i latou e le peresitene, ona tulai lea o le Alii ma afio mai lona afioaga lilo, ma i lona toasa ua lutia ai le atunuu;

verses.en: And in his hot displeasure, and in his fierce anger, in his time, will cut off those wicked, unfaithful, and unjust stewards, and appoint them their portion among hypocrites, and unbelievers;
verses.sm: Ma o le a ia vavae ese i le aasa o lona lē fiafia, ma i lona toasa tele, i lona taimi, i latou na o tausimea amioleaga, lē faamaoni, ma lē tonu, ma tofi atu ia te i latou la latou vaega i totonu o tagata pepelo, ma e e lē talitonu;

verses.en: Even in outer darkness, where there is weeping, and wailing, and gnashing of teeth.
verses.sm: I le pogisa lava i fafo, i le mea e i ai le tagi, ma le auē, ma le lilivau o nifo.

verses.en: Pray ye, therefore, that their ears may be opened unto your cries, that I may be merciful unto them, that these things may not come upon them.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou tatalo ai, ina ia tatala mai o latou taliga ia outou tagi, ina ia Ou alofa mutimutivale ia te i latou, ina ia lē oo mai ia mea i luga o i latou.

verses.en: What I have said unto you must needs be, that all men may be left without excuse;
verses.sm: O mea ua Ou fai atu ai ia te outou e tatau ona i ai, ina ia tuua tagata uma e aunoa ma se ’alofaga.

verses.en: That wise men and rulers may hear and know that which they have never considered;
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai e tagata atamamai ma pule ona faalogo ma iloa mea latou te lei manatu lava i ai;

verses.en: That I may proceed to bring to pass my act, my strange act, and perform my work, my strange work, that men may discern between the righteous and the wicked, saith your God.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona Ou faagasolo e faataunuu la’u faiga, o la’u faiga uiga ese, ma fai la’u galuega, o la’u galuega uiga ese, ina ia mafai ona iloatino e tagata le eseesega o le amiotonu ma le amioleaga, ua fetalai mai ai lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, it is contrary to my commandment and my will that my servant Sidney Gilbert should sell my storehouse, which I have appointed unto my people, into the hands of mine enemies.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua lē tusa ai ma la’u poloaiga ma lo’u loto ona tatau ona faatau atu e la’u auauna o Sini Gilbert i lima o o’u fili, lo’u faleteuoloa, lea na Ou tofia mo lo’u nuu.

verses.en: Let not that which I have appointed be polluted by mine enemies, by the consent of those who call themselves after my name;
verses.sm: Ia lē tuuina atu mea ua Ou tofia ia faaeleeleaina e o’u fili, i se maliega a i latou o e ua valaauina i latou lava i lo’u igoa;

verses.en: For this is a very sore and grievous sin against me, and against my people, in consequence of those things which I have decreed and which are soon to befall the nations.
verses.sm: Ona o se agasala tiga tele lenei ma mamafa e faasaga mai ia te a’u, ma faasaga i lo’u nuu, ona o mea na ua Ou folafola atu ma ua lata ona pa’u’ū mai i atunuu.

verses.en: Therefore, it is my will that my people should claim, and hold claim upon that which I have appointed unto them, though they should not be permitted to dwell thereon.
verses.sm: O lea, o lo’u loto e tatau i lo’u nuu ona aiā, ma taofi le aiā i luga o mea na Ou tofia ia te i latou, e ui ina lē faatagaina i latou e nonofo ai iina.

verses.en: Nevertheless, I do not say they shall not dwell thereon; for inasmuch as they bring forth fruit and works meet for my kingdom they shall dwell thereon.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, Ou te lē o fai atu ia latou lē nonofo iina; ona e tusa ai ma le latou aumaia o fua ma galuega tatau ai mo lo’u malo o le a latou nonofo ai iina.

verses.en: They shall build, and another shall not inherit it; they shall plant vineyards, and they shall eat the fruit thereof. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: O le a latou atia’e, ma o le a lē avea ma tofi o se tasi e ese mai; o le a latou totō tovine, ma o le a latou ’ai ona fua. E faapea lava. Amene.
